visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) [People]: A woman with a black ponytail wearing a white cotton t-shirt sits on a bed, smiling and looking intently at a TV screen. [Objects]: The TV displays a vibrant cartoon video game with glowing purple and green lights. [Setting]: The setting is a clean, modern indoor bedroom with white cabinets and soft lighting. [Text]: White Chinese subtitles and a black variety-style caption in parentheses appear at the bottom. (2) [People]: A young toddler with two small pigtails and a strawberry-print pajama top sits on the bed, pointing towards the TV and then looking at the camera with a curious expression. [Objects]: The woman holds a black game controller as the game environment shows colorful flowers and cartoon characters. [Setting]: The bedroom includes a grey air purifier and scattered pillows. [Text]: Multiple lines of Chinese subtitles and variety-show style text like captions for 'satisfied' or 'pointing' appear on screen. (3) [People]: The woman laughs broadly with her eyes closed, displaying a joyful expression as she interacts with the child. The little girl stands up on the wooden floor and performs a small dance, moving her arms and legs rhythmically. [Objects]: The room features a wooden stool, a window with blinds, and a grey pet bed. [Setting]: The camera perspective shifts to show more of the room's wooden flooring and layout. [Text]: Subtitles continue to track the dialogue and describe the girl's movements such as 'dancing' or 'looking!'. (4) [People]: An animated sequence shows a simple cartoon illustration of a man and a woman on a solid light yellow background. [Objects]: The man is lying down while the woman stands next to him. [Setting]: A graphic digital environment replaces the live room setting. [Text]: The logo 'CUI'S FAMILY LIFE' is displayed in the center in a clean, sans-serif font.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A woman's cheerful and high-pitched voice exclaims in Chinese, immediately followed by the high-arousal giggle of a young girl. Upbeat, moderate-tempo synthesizer BGM with a clear 4/4 electronic drum beat plays continuously. The woman's vocal delivery is playful and highly animated, setting a joyous tone. (2) A short, bright electronic 'ding' sound effect punctuates the conversation. The woman and child engage in a melodic call-and-response dialogue with frequent rising intonations. The background environmental noise is a very low-intensity indoor room tone, ensuring the vocal and music signals remain crisp and clear. (3) The rhythmic synthesizer BGM continues as the child's voice increases in volume and excitement, sounding like a joyful shout. A subtle 'whoosh' sound effect marks a transition in their playful exchange. The woman's hearty laughter is layered prominently over the background music, creating a high-energy acoustic atmosphere. (4) The speech density remains high as the woman encourages the child with fast-paced, high-arousal speech patterns. The BGM concludes with a final bright melodic jingle that fades out smoothly. The child produces several rhythmic, high-pitched vocalizations in imitation of a sound effect, ending the audio track.
